description: Searches project files for text or a regular expression, one entry per matching line. It skips dot names, addons gdharness installed, and folders holding a .gdignore or their own project.godot.

fileTypes.description: Extensions to search, such as ["gd", "tscn"]. Default: every text file.

maxResults.description: How many matching lines to answer. Default 100.

path.description: A folder or file inside the project to search, such as "res://src". Default: the whole project.

query.description: The text or pattern to find.

regex.description: Read the query as a regular expression. Default false.

name: project_search
title: Search the project
